tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The dot sits directly on it. Dark ground is true black, never navy.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, chips and sections raised one step above bg. Keep the blue dot on bg or bg-raised only.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for secondary buttons and rows. The dot falls under 3:1 on the dark value, so never place the dot on it.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of inputs and other controls. 3:1 or better on bg and bg-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, bg-raised and bg-hover. Links use ink with a brand underline.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper text on bg, bg-raised and bg-hover (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text and decorative icons. Large text and icons on bg only. Not for body text.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Yolk Blue. The dot, primary button fill, focus ring, link underline, current-page marker. Light value on light grounds, Lit value on dark grounds. Never a background theme, never tinted.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (6.34:1 on light, 4.75:1 on dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Yolk Gold. 2% of a view or less, one element per view: the loader fill, one highlight. Never as text on a light ground (1.79:1 on white).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (9.48:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error icons and error borders. Always paired with an icon and a word, never color alone. Outside the brand palette.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons. Always paired with an icon and a word. Outside the brand palette.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. Always paired with an icon and a word. Kept darker and more orange than accent so the two never read as the same.

families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles. Bricolage Grotesque 700. Use only at 19px and above.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and block headings. 19px is the smallest size for this family.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy sits in Outfit at 16 over 26.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels only (set the text in caps). +14% tracking.

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: Bodoni Moda 500. One per layout, large sizes only, never body text, never in the wordmark.

styles.name: ar-h1
styles.usage: Arabic page titles. About 15% larger than the English h1. No letter-spacing.

styles.name: ar-caption
styles.usage: Arabic captions and helper text. Arabic labels use weight and size, never tracking or caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap and page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Large section breaks and hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, text areas.

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Photos, video and avatars. Rounded rectangles only, never a circle crop.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips. Fully round.
